messages:
lucy.release: Promo blocked — deploy-bot failed preflight for web-frontend:2026-04-canary. Error says artifact verification mismatch. Anyone near a console?

deploy-bot: Promotion halted: artifact checksum mismatch for web-frontend:2026-04-canary. Expected manifest digest sha256:aaabbb..., found sha256:cccddd... between cache and registry.

mike.ci: Looking. CI finished and pushed to staging registry. I see that the buildkite artifact upload retried once due to transient GCS timeout; maybe the retry re-compressed the layer.

tara.sre: Can you paste skopeo/regctl outputs?

mike.ci: Pasting quick diffs: staging layer digests: sha256:111xxx. cached artifact blob (from remote cache) digest: sha256:222yyy. Size same. Likely gzip metadata diff.

lucy.release: Short term decision? Pin to last good and delay?

tara.sre: Short term: pin promo to redwood/web-frontend@sha256:goodzz and hold. I'll add manual hold tag.

mike.ci: I'll re-push canonical blobs from CI artifact store with reproducible gzip flags (--no-name --no-time) to prod registry and then re-run verification.

artifact-bot: Copy started: regctl copy gcs://bk-artifacts/web-frontend/2026-04-canary.tar -> docker://gcr.io/redwood-prod/web-frontend:2026-04-canary (gzip opts applied).

(4m later) mike.ci: Re-push completed. skopeo inspect now shows layer digest sha256:111xxx on prod matching staging.

artifact-bot: Manifest verification OK: staging and prod match on manifest sha256:aaabbb...

deploy-bot: Preflight passed for web-frontend:2026-04-canary. No mismatches. Ready to unhold.

lucy.release: Unholding and promoting. Note for release notes: "Canary briefly held due to artifact checksum drift from non-deterministic compression during retry; resolved by re-pushing deterministic blobs."

tara.sre: Opening infra ticket INFRA-7901 to add deterministic gzip flags to the artifact uploader.

lucy.release: Thanks, leaving pin for 10m of monitoring then full flip.

mike.ci: 10m lookgood.

lucy.release: closing thread.
